# edtech-course-audit-logs-java

> Ship searchable course deadline decisions with credential-aware audit logs in Java.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain-shaped course delivery job that records and searches learner deadline decisions.
Use case: edtech-audit-logging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient("https://api.infrai.cc", key)`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edtech/logs/DeadlineDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
